summary: A responsive, single-page static portfolio website built with Bootstrap 5, featuring smooth navigation, print-friendly layout, and zero build-step requirements for optimal performance.
key_features: Fixed sidebar with ScrollSpy & auto-collapsing mobile menu
Structured content sections (About, Experience, Education, Skills)
Direct external integrations (GitHub, LinkedIn, Telegram, Email)
achievements: Successfully customized and extended a base template into a fully responsive, zero-dependency static site. Implemented vanilla JS for ScrollSpy initialization and mobile navigation toggle logic. Optimized media assets (SVGs, WebP) for fast loading and cross-browser compatibility. Designed a structured content management workflow using a reference data file, enabling seamless updates without build steps. Configured architecture for frictionless deployment across GitHub Pages, Netlify, and Vercel.
